name: Beauty and the Bodyguard
source:
This night is very special to you. You deserved a night out, to celebrate and relax. You're a step away from the big screen, already imagining yourself as the heroine of a movie. You're not even aware of the fact that the movie of your life starts tonight... Who will be the lead actor?

[From in-app]
translation:
这个夜晚对你来说非常特别。你值得度过一个夜晚，庆祝和放松。你距离大银幕仅一步之遥，已经将自己想象成电影的女主角。你甚至不知道你生命中的电影今晚就要开始……谁将成为主角？

[来自应用程序内]
